doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Jo Jones and Prez at McClellan; the Thornhill drummer teaches him to read
summary: Jo and Prez were stationed there too, and a drummer from Claude Thornhill's band taught him to read drum music in the woods.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: You’re saying you were at Fort McLellan and Prez showed up. He was stationed there as well. So you were stationed together.
Oh, yeah. Prez and Jo Jones both.

Jo Jones. Oh, let me tell you. The hippest thing that happened to me there, damn near had his name then, but anyway, the drummer that was with Claude Thornhill, I can’t think of his name right now but it will come to me. I’ll tell you tonight. But anyway we used to meet. We hooked up in the middle of the two hills in the woods. He would bring his book and a practice pad and I would bring my practice pad. He taught me how to read music, drum music. Taught me how to read drum music, man.
So there was one good thing about the army.
So there was one good thing about the army.
Yeah. And I was in there for five years, man.
